summary: Very steep short kerb by a church and a main-road junction.
reasons: No Stopping and No Parking signs

drivers.seclusion: Flats and houses 13-19 m away; church 15 m; houses front the street.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along the kerb; room to pull in.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street but meets a busy main road at the end.
drivers.convention: Cars park along it, but No Stopping and No Parking Any Time signs apply near the corner.

flags: Dwelling 8 m from the far end
Junction with a busy main road adds noise
sun_shade: Open to the north and east; some tree shade near the corner.

best_section.where: Armadale Street south kerb, opposite the church, near the lawn beside the flats
